description.value: Petite Bao is a Kitsilano restaurant specializing in Asian-influenced bao burgers made with handmade, daily-fresh bao buns and locally sourced, organic, non-GMO ingredients from BC farmers. The menu spans pork belly, wagyu, B.C. salmon, and several vegetarian/vegan options, alongside sides like poutine and wings. Situated on the West Broadway cycling corridor, it offers dine-in and online ordering with catering available for events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (2825 West Broadway, V6K2G6) and adds phone (604-800-0080). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website displays two conflicting sets of business hours on the same page (footer shows Wed–Mon 11am–9pm / Tuesday closed; contact section shows Mon–Thu 11am–9pm / Fri–Sun 11am–10pm), suggesting the site may have stale or inconsistently maintained content.
No bike parking information found on website or in OSM tags — on-site verification recommended before confirming the Bike parking or visibility criterion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant on the West Broadway cycling corridor in Kitsilano with online ordering, vegetarian/GF options, and locally sourced ingredients — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists, pending on-site confirmation of bike parking.
